description: Cancel a booking. Free cancellation 12+ hours before pickup — no admin fee. Under 12 hours cannot be cancelled via this tool — the customer must call the office on +44 20 8688 7744. Ask the customer for BOTH their booking reference AND the email address used at booking — same as our website manage-booking login. Do not call this tool without both values.

booking_ref.description: Booking reference — either "APL-<LT reservation id>" (e.g. "APL-1013869", as on the confirmation email) or the numeric LT reservation ID (e.g. "966244"). Both formats accepted.

email.description: Passenger email on the booking — required, must match exactly

name: cancel_booking
